attachments.displayName: Something I've had on my to-do list for a long time... A wifi-enabled humidity sensor. I'm using a #spark core to read a DHT11 sensor and send the temperature and humidity to a Google spreadsheet to graph the values over time. Then I have a script on the spreadsheet that notifies my phone via #pushover. I've gotten this far but I want to power it from a battery and that's going to take some extra planning. I'm still thinking of the best way to put it in a low power mode and still ensure it sends out data at a reasonable rate.
